---
title: How to cite the dashboard
toc: False
---

If you use the Safer Parks Dashboard in your work, we ask that you please acknowledge and cite us.

## Dashboard

If you use insights, screenshots, text, or images from the dashboard in your work, please cite us in your work as follows:

> Maeve Murphy Quinlan, Anna Barker, Melissa Barrientos, Victoria Houlden, Francesca Pontin (2026): The Safer Parks Dashboard. University of Leeds. https://doi.org/10.5518/1951. Accessed: <time id="cite-accessed-date"></time>

<script>
  (function () {
    var now = new Date();
    var el = document.getElementById('cite-accessed-date');
    el.dateTime = now.toLocaleDateString('en-CA');
    el.textContent = now.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
  })();
</script>

### Published image or screenshot captions

In addition to citing us in the text of your work, please include a caption containing this information in any published screenshots from the dashboard (note that this is not required for internal documents):

> Source: Screenshot from the Safer Parks Dashboard (Murphy Quinlan et al., 2026), University of Leeds. DOI: 10.5518/1951. Includes OpenStreetMap-derived content and map data, together with derived datasets incorporating information licensed under the UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Where shown, toilet facility data are © 2025 Toilet Map (CC BY 4.0). Other third-party data may be subject to separate licences and attribution requirements; full layer attribution statements are available on the Safer Parks Dashboard. Captured: [Add date here]

Please update the timestamp to match the date the image was captured or downloaded. Where multiple screenshots or images are included in a document, this can be included once as opposed to duplicated for each.

## Illustrations 

Illustrations are by [Harper Perry](https://www.harperperry.co.uk/) and [Josie Brookes Illustration](https://www.josiebrookes.com/), all rights reserved.

## Data

If you download data from the dashboard following the "Download Data" link on the dashboard sidebar, the appropriate citation is provided alongside the relevant dataset.

If you use data read directly from the dashboard, without downloading supplementary data files, please just use the dashboard citation provided above.
